title: Courier Load Balancer
summary: A delivery hub splits the day's parcels between couriers. Fix an unfair tie-break, respect van capacity, then plan a festival-week hub with tens of thousands of couriers.
followUps: Why did the plans look reasonable even with the wrong tie-break, and what did the drivers notice?
Heaviest first is a heuristic. Give a small input where the greedy plan is not the best possible, and how far from best it can be.
What is the cost of balance for n parcels and m couriers, before and after your change?
Couriers now have different van sizes. Does 'give it to the least-loaded courier' still work? What would you do instead?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
